section3: Alan's hard-won take: SPEED is what most home service owners get wrong — both speed-to-lead (initial response) AND speed across the client journey (follow-up, issue resolution). Poor speed kills LTV and retention.

This take bridges his two experiences: door-knocking sales (where speed = close-on-the-spot) + operating cleaning business (where speed = retention). Positioning angle: he can preach speed with credibility from both sides.
Concrete speed rule Alan preaches: SMS + email within 1 minute, phone call within 5 minutes for a new lead. This is a specific, defendable positioning line.

Value gaps Alan spots in home services: (1) websites not built to convert, (2) no/bad SEO, (3) zero organic Instagram content. Matches his current offer stack exactly.
